payload.task: Set the rules for this round: hypotheses, constraint updates, and the prior/model weights. The program selects the batch under them.

components.name: mpnn
components.provenance: ProteinMPNN ProteinMPNN soluble v_48_002 log-odds on RCSB 2GB1 chain A (56 aa NMR structure of the GB1 domain); muted at site (40,) because zero-shot scores mis-rank that position

components.name: packing_headroom
components.provenance: penalty for added side-chain volume, scaled by the clash severity of the reconstructed C-beta in 1PGA (per-site severity {39: 0.0, 40: 0.0, 41: 0.93, 54: 0.0})

components.name: burial_charge
components.provenance: desolvation penalty for a formal charge, scaled by relative SASA in 1PGA

components.name: interface_bonus
components.provenance: bonus for large/aromatic side chains at positions that bury surface against IgG-Fc in 1FCC (buried area per site: {39: 1.7, 40: 41.9, 41: 7.2, 54: 0.5})

components.name: pair_volume_compensation
components.provenance: volume transfer between sites 41 and 54: the strongest published positive epistasis (G41L/V54G) works by moving side-chain volume from the buried core to the loop, and V54A flips site-41 substitutions from deleterious to beneficial

components.name: literature
components.provenance: per-substitution claims from the curated evidence base, weighted by confidence; rows derived from the oracle DMS excluded

current_constraints.description: a variant whose label is already known is never selected again
where the backbone leaves no room, added side-chain volume is capped
current_constraints.evidence: reconstructed C-beta within 3.0 A of a neighbouring heavy atom at sites [41] (1PGA); a cap, not a ban, because the published G41L/V54G pair shows the strain can be compensated elsewhere

current_constraints.description: burying a formal charge costs score
current_constraints.evidence: buried sites [39, 54]; desolvation penalty for charged side chains

current_constraints.description: two new buried charges in one variant are penalised together
current_constraints.evidence: desolvation cost is super-additive when several charges are buried

current_constraints.description: each site shows at least k distinct amino acids in the batch
current_constraints.evidence: exploration requirement: a batch that collapses onto one motif cannot inform the next model

current_constraints.description: a fixed share of the batch comes from outside the top of the ranking
current_constraints.evidence: epistatic landscape: the ranking is trained on few labels and is unreliable in the tail

current_constraints.description: candidates that remove every large side chain from the Fc contact positions are penalised
current_constraints.evidence: sites burying >= 10 A^2 against IgG-Fc in 1FCC: [40] (off by default; the agent may switch it on)

current_constraints.description: substitutions whose registered hypothesis was refuted lose score
current_constraints.evidence: set from the program's verdict on the previous round's hypotheses

hypothesis_verdicts.statement: At site 41, alanine combined with a small site-54 residue (A/G) yields higher fitness than glycine with the same site-54 context.
At site 40, histidine appears more often in the top quartile than its batch frequency predicts.
At site 39, aromatic substitutions (F/W/Y) underperform aliphatic ones (V/I/L) in this batch.
At site 54, alanine is enriched among variants with fitness above 1.5 relative to the batch mean.

required_output.hypotheses: 3 to 4 items of {statement, site, substitution, direction}; each statement at most 25 words and testable by the next batch
required_output.constraint_updates: list of {id, params, active, reason}; only ids listed in current_constraints; reason at most 25 words; [] is allowed
required_output.weights: {prior: float in [0,2], model: float in [0,2]} for this round's score
required_output.rationale: at most 60 words on why these rules follow from the evidence so far

response: {"hypotheses": [{"statement": "At site 39, aromatic substitutions (F/W/Y) with small site-54 residues (A/G) exceed aliphatic V/I/L in the same context.", "site": 39, "substitution": "F", "direction": "higher"}, {"statement": "At site 40, tryptophan paired with site-41 alanine outperforms other site-40 aromatics given the same site-39/54 background.", "site": 40, "substitution": "W", "direction": "higher"}, {"statement": "At site 41, alanine with site-54 alanine yields higher fitness than glycine with site-54 glycine.", "site": 41, "substitution": "A", "direction": "higher"}, {"statement": "At site 54, alanine exceeds glycine when site 41 is alanine but not when site 41 is glycine.", "site": 54, "substitution": "A", "direction": "higher"}], "constraint_updates": [{"id": "C2_volume_window", "params": {"sites": [41], "max_added_volume": 120.0}, "active": true, "reason": "G41L/V54G epistasis and supported G41A result show strain is compensable; relax cap to admit more site-41 chemistry."}, {"id": "C8_refuted_substitutions", "params": {"substitutions": {"G41A": 0.0, "D40H": -0.5, "V54A": 0.0}, "weight": 0.5}, "active": true, "reason": "G41A and V54A were supported this round; drop their penalties, keep D40H penalised."}, {"id": "C7_interface_contact", "params": {"sites": [40], "weight": 0.2}, "active": true, "reason": "Site 40 aromatics dominate top variants; keep mild penalty to preserve Fc-contact bulk."}], "weights": {"prior": 1.0, "model": 1.4}, "rationale": "Model under-predicted top variants by ~4-5 units, so raise model weight now that 384 labels exist. Relaxing the site-41 volume cap and clearing supported-substitution penalties opens the G41A/V54A motif that produced the best measured variants."}
